estimates.assumptions: Measurement given as 200g; using exactly as supplied for the entire edible portion of sugar snap peas (raw).
Standard medium spring onion ~15g each when trimmed and sliced; 4 onions = 60g total edible portion.
A 'handful' of fresh coriander is typically ~20g of leaves and tender stems.
Measurement given as 150g; using exactly as supplied for the entire edible hot-smoked flaked salmon (cooked, no skin/bone).
'To serve' with one pretzel or bread roll per person; estimating one typical soft pretzel at ~30g edible portion (modest single serving).
1 tablespoon of groundnut oil weighs ~14g (standard density for vegetable oils).
A 'knob' of fresh ginger root for a dressing is typically a 10g peeled piece.
